title: KF hook-point catalog
description: The shape of the hook-point catalog. generates two catalogs from the @HookPoint declarations: the complete one (every point) and the release one (public points only); the SDKs and the validation of public modules read only the release one. This schema holds no point: the catalogs do. The attributes of $defs.point are, name for name, the attributes of the @HookPoint annotation (HookPointSchemaParityTest). Uniqueness of an id inside a catalog is enforced by the generator and its drift test, which JSON Schema cannot express.

catalogVersion.description: The version of the catalog format; 1 for the form fixed.

platformVersion.description: The semver of the platform the catalog was generated from.

variant.description: complete: every point, internal and public; release: only the public points.

point.description: One hook point, as declared by @HookPoint.

id.description: {entity}.{before|after|field}.{action}; a point type of the registry.

phase.description: before: synchronous, in the transaction; after-commit: asynchronous, at least once.

entity.description: The logical name of the @ExtensibleEntity; the first segment of id.

envelope.description: The shape of data: kf.change (entity, id, before, after, changed) or kf.field-change (plus field, oldValue, newValue).

visibility.description: internal: platform modules only; public: in the release catalog and the SDK constants.

veto.description: Whether a module may reject the mutation; before points only.

patch.description: The entity's own fields a module may patch; before points only.

timeoutMs.description: The callback timeout of this point, in milliseconds.

defaultOnFailure.description: The policy when a callback fails and the module chose none; block on before points only, and a module asking for block needs the capability.

capability.description: The manifest list the id must appear in as point (capabilities.hooks[].point).

fieldFilter.description: Whether a subscription may filter on field paths; field points only.
